connector.name: Power Automate MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Inspect, operate, and author Microsoft Power Automate cloud flows from an agent context.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package power-automate-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sapientsai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: AZURE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Application (client) ID of your Entra app registration (multi-tenant public client).

env.name: AZURE_TENANT_ID
env.description: Tenant GUID. Required for the Flow audience ('common' fails with AADSTS50059).

env.name: AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Client secret — only for clientCredentials mode.

env.name: ENABLE_WRITE_OPS
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable mutating tools (default read-only).

env.name: DEFAULT_ENVIRONMENT
env.description: Environment id used when a tool omits 'environment'.
